headline: Fox Mandal & Associates advises EXIM Bank on financing Jana Nayagan
sum: Export-Import Bank of India has sanctioned an additional movie financing facility of ₹50 crore extended to KVN Group for the feature film Jana Nayagan, recently released as the final film of C. Joseph Vijay, the current Chief Minister of…
detail: Export-Import Bank of India has sanctioned an additional movie financing facility of ₹50 crore extended to KVN Group for the feature film Jana Nayagan, recently released as the final film of C. Joseph Vijay, the current Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu. Fox Mandal & Associates advised EXIM Bank on this financing deal. The transaction team consisted Prashantha Kumar (Senior Partner), Pooja Upadhya (Group Head), Raashmi Arun Prakash (Senior Associate), Associates Prateek Pandey, Mahek Harichandan, Kritika Chaudhary, Anurag Kumar and Akash Patil.
